title: Cisternal regions in real native T2 MRI
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Explore six regional teaching anchors in full native T2 sections alongside source brainstem labels, then magnify each recorded location for closer observation.

scenes.title: Prepontine region · MRI observation
scenes.prompt: Start with complete source sections, then use Magnify at cursor. Observe the narrow image region anterior to the pons. Follow adjacent sections and distinguish bright fluid signal from dark vascular signal and partial-volume effects.
scenes.note: Instructor-editable regional observation anchor in the original T2 MRI. The source image retains its 1 mm sampling and its independently delivered label grid. The anatomical surfaces represent the listed source brainstem structures; the regional annotation records a teaching location. Expert assessment of each recorded location is tracked separately.

image_anchor.label: Prepontine region
image_anchor.reference: University at Buffalo, Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, Neuroscience and Behavior: Subarachnoid Cisterns. https://ubneuro-ccohan.webapps.buffalo.edu/cisterns.html (accessed 2026-10-13). Reference terminology only; MRI and anchors use the independently acquired SPL/NAC source.
